pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar" to try
set today to current date
set startDate to today
set endDate to today + (90 * days)
set eventsDeleted to false
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
try
repeat
set yogaEvent to first event of currentCalendar whose (start date ≥ startDate and start date ≤ endDate and summary is "Yoga Class")
delete yogaEvent
set eventsDeleted to true
end repeat
on error
end try
end repeat
return eventsDeleted
on error
return false
end try'
instruction: Create a recurring event titled 'Yoga Class' every Friday at 5 PM for the next three months.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events"
if not (exists process "Calendar") then
return false
end if
end tell
tell application "Calendar"
try
set today to (current date)
set startDate to today
set endDate to today + (90 * days)
set eventFound to false
set allTimesCorrect to true
set isRecurring to false
set allDaysCorrect to true
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
try
set eventsInRange to (every event of currentCalendar whose start date ≥ startDate and start date ≤ endDate)
repeat with currentEvent in eventsInRange
try
set eventSummary to summary of currentEvent
if eventSummary contains "Yoga Class" then
set eventFound to true
set eventDate to start date of currentEvent
if weekday of eventDate is not Friday then
set allDaysCorrect to false
end if
set eventTime to time of eventDate
set eventHours to eventTime div hours
if eventHours is not 17 then
set allTimesCorrect to false
end if
try
set recurrenceInfo to recurrence of currentEvent
if recurrenceInfo is not missing value then
set isRecurring to true
end if
on error
end try
end if
on error
end try
end repeat
on error
end try
end repeat
return (eventFound and allTimesCorrect and isRecurring and allDaysCorrect)
on error
return false
end try
end tell'
